author: ojiudezue
title: 3b keeps the empty-house anchor on per-NVR holds (A); direction set: one physical camera, two NVR witnesses
summary: Ship 3b makes camera-down pages fire only when every NVR has lost a camera, but the census-p2 empty-house anchor still blocks on each NVR's own hold. The operator took option A (keep it, fold the anchor into DEAD-CAMERA-TWIN-COVERAGE-1) and set the longer direction: model each physical camera once with Frigate and Protect as two witnesses, so every reader asks about the camera, not a per-NVR entity. 3b's fix-up also chose a bounded DEFER (rooms wait up to the 600 s boot settle for the camera-twin owner, then page) over a plain PAGE.
why: Option B (anchor follows 'every NVR lost it') only works if the twin NVR's sensor covers the same room; without that check the anchor can reset the ledger to residents-only while a guest sits in a room only the dead Frigate input watched. That check is the coverage design whose four plan rounds each found a HIGH path to a wrong answer. A's cost is at most 15 extra minutes before the count resets during a one-NVR outage, and the hold errs toward 'not empty'. The bounded DEFER exists because a plain PAGE sent a false HIGH after every CM reload while a Protect twin still saw the camera; review D2 measured the worst-case room page delay at about 660 s and found no silent path.
alternatives_considered: B: move the anchor to physical-camera-dead in 3b (reopens Tier 3 reviews and needs the coverage rules)
Plain PAGE when the owner is not ready (false HIGH after each CM reload)
implications: Every camera reader (room inputs, holds, census, zones, ledger anchor, perimeter single-source gate, transit platform counts) still treats Frigate and Protect entities as separate cameras until NVR-WITNESS-CONSOLIDATION-1 W2 builds the one-camera model; W2 must extend 3b's CameraTwinHealth rather than add a second liveness model, and it absorbs card B. Interior vision (arc step 9) should wait for it.
revisit_trigger: A one-NVR hold visibly delays a displayed census count reset, or W2 planning starts.
operator_quote: A recommended is fine. But we do have to eventually figure how to not deal with 2 camera system in this idiosyncratic way as it they are watching diff cameras instead of the same
